{
  "problem_id": "TA-004",
  "lane_id": "openai-governed",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "OpenAI frontier reasoning-model agents with long-context models, embedding retrieval, code execution, theorem-prover sandboxes, and isolated independent verifier instances",
  "execution_posture": "governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 7500000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 1200000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 22000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 320,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 282,
  "estimated_retries": 140,
  "estimated_search_cost": 180000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 320000,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 720000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 1500000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 4500000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 15000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 7000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 17500,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 35000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.12,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.52,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.08,
  "confidence": 0.27,
  "assumptions": [
    "This is a prospective bottom-up resource estimate, not a claim of observed feasibility and not anchored to any published aggregate estimate.",
    "Independent rediscovery uses a quarantined literature corpus excluding the known counterexample and proof while allowing prerequisite work available before an agreed cutoff. A separate reproduction evaluation may inspect the published proof only after the independent artifact is frozen and hashed.",
    "Success means producing a publication-ready counterexample matching the target, with all group-theoretic and operator-algebraic claims reconstructed, computationally checked where applicable, and accepted by multiple isolated critic agents.",
    "Reproduction probability refers to reconstructing and validating a known published argument when that argument is available. Independent-result probability refers to obtaining the result without access to its decisive construction or proof.",
    "The central plan includes literature ingestion and dependency mapping, 320 materially distinct construction or proof branches, computational experiments, adversarial critic cycles, proof reconstruction, partial formalization, clean-room replication, and manuscript preparation.",
    "Token figures aggregate all research, critic, verifier, summarization, retrieval, and manuscript agents. Reasoning tokens are planning quantities and may not correspond directly to externally visible or separately billed tokens.",
    "Central governance overhead of 320000 USD is allocated approximately as follows: identity and artifact hashing 25000; budget enforcement and quota controls 45000; branch receipts and lineage tracking 85000; evidence preservation and immutable storage 70000; policy and contamination checks 35000; governance audits and recovery testing 60000.",
    "Central verification cost of 720000 USD includes isolated proof reconstruction 220000; theorem-prover development and partial formalization 280000; clean-room computational replication 140000; and adversarial consistency, novelty, and citation checks 80000.",
    "Search cost covers corpus acquisition, retrieval and indexing, citation-graph exploration, mathematical database access, and sandboxed exploratory computation. It excludes inference already represented in the token estimates.",
    "Total costs include model inference, orchestration, storage, search, mathematical software, theorem-prover engineering, computational experiments, governance, verification, replication, and preparation of a submission-quality manuscript.",
    "Elapsed time is wall-clock time under parallel execution, not the sum of agent-hours. The low case assumes an early viable construction; the high case includes repeated redesigns and substantial missing formal-library work."
  ],
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "Whether the decisive construction is discoverable from prerequisite literature without contamination from the known solution",
    "The amount of tacit expert judgment needed in deformation-rigidity, group construction, and von Neumann algebra classification arguments",
    "The number of plausible but subtly invalid candidate counterexamples",
    "Availability and adequacy of formal libraries for operator algebras, measured equivalence relations, and required group theory",
    "Difficulty translating analytic arguments into machine-checkable statements",
    "Context-window, long-horizon planning, and branch-management reliability",
    "Cost and latency of frontier reasoning models at execution time",
    "Need for bespoke computational invariants or large experimental searches",
    "Standards imposed by journal referees for novelty, exposition, and verification",
    "Risk that clean-room independence cannot be convincingly established after broad literature ingestion"
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A precisely stated pair or family of groups satisfying the target hypotheses",
    "A complete proof that the relevant von Neumann algebras are isomorphic in the required sense",
    "A complete proof that the groups are not isomorphic and are distinguished by independently checked invariants",
    "Explicit verification that every hypothesis of the conjecture being refuted applies",
    "A dependency ledger with exact citations for every imported theorem and no hidden reliance on the quarantined proof",
    "Machine-checkable calculations or reproducible code for every computational claim",
    "At least two isolated verifier reconstructions from the frozen statement and dependency package",
    "Adversarial checks for degenerate cases, convention mismatches, circular reasoning, and incorrect theorem applicability",
    "Partial formalization of the fragile core lemmas, with a documented trusted base for portions not formalized",
    "A clean-room replication report, immutable branch receipts, evidence hashes, and a submission-ready manuscript"
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "No current guarantee that autonomous model agents can sustain the novel conceptual reasoning required for this research program",
    "Known-solution leakage could invalidate the independent-rediscovery claim even if the mathematical artifact is correct",
    "Core operator-algebra arguments may depend on expert intuition that is difficult to recover through brute-force branching",
    "Formal proof assistants may lack essential definitions and theorem libraries, making full formalization disproportionately expensive",
    "Verification of von Neumann algebra isomorphism may involve analytic details poorly supported by automated tooling",
    "A candidate may survive computational tests while failing a subtle hypothesis or structural lemma",
    "Publication still depends on external novelty assessment and referee judgment not controlled by the autonomous system"
  ]
}
